name: Inagaki Vanilla
source:
Twin sisters, and students at one of SORD’s other campuses, Keihin Sakuragaoka.
The two agents hail from Alaska, where they used to assist the security services in cracking down on drugs and weapons smugglers and the Russian mafia.
It seems that the younger of the two, Choco, was once good friends with [url=/c53939]Rena[/url].

"Don't yawn like that while you're on the job. This is an escort mission - be a little more vigilant, won't you?"

[From [url=http://grisaia-pt.com/en/index.html]official site[/url]]
